content.rendered:
?

Isaiah 37:34 KJV
By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.
?
Back in the days…. The king of Assyria was more than confident he would overrun the people of God, but, alas, the Lord defended His own.

??The same way that life threatening symptoms or sickness came into your body, it will return.

??The same way that strange woman came, even with the intent of destroying your beautiful home, she shall return.

??The same way the economic situation came to turn your business upside down, it shall return.

??The same way the enemy got a stronghold on your finances, he shall return.

??The same way that negative report that stole your joy away came, so it shall return.

??Whatever has besieged you trying to steal your joy away will return the same way it came.
?
Jeremiah 1:18b MSG
…I’m making you as impregnable as a castle, Immovable as a steel post, solid as a concrete block wall. You’re a one-man defense system against this culture, Against Judah’s kings and princes, against the priests and local leaders.

??You are IMPREGNABLE… therefore, you cannot be harassed .

The days of fear & trepidation are over for good.

You will reach your goals in Jesus name??????

????????
(Pls be reminded of Saturday’s Prayer Walk at Adamasingba stadium, Ibadan…from 7.30am-9am.

Why just walk ??to exercise when you can walk?? & pray??

Its Non-Denominational .

its for the whole family)
